title: vLLM completions -- T1499 pure prompt-embeds payload with M-RoPE model fatally crashes EngineCore
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin observed rules (derived from breach corpus)
description:
Vendor-disclosed detection for CVE-2026-55514 (GHSA-33cg-gxv8-3p8g,
CVSS 7.1 HIGH), affecting vLLM from 0.12.0 before 0.24.0.

Sending a pure prompt-embeds payload in a `/v1/completions` request,
against a model configured to use M-RoPE (multimodal rotary position
embeddings), causes `EngineCore` to fail an internal assertion and
FATALLY CRASH -- shutting down the entire server process, not just the
offending request. Unlike vLLM's typical request-level error handling,
this specific combination reaches an unrecoverable assertion failure at
the engine level. Any remote user merely AUTHORIZED to make a normal
`/v1/completions` request (no special privilege needed beyond ordinary
API access) can induce the crash and take down the service for every
other user.

Detection logic flags a `/v1/completions` request carrying a
prompt-embeds payload with no accompanying text prompt (the "pure"
shape the advisory specifies) directed at a model configured for
M-RoPE -- the exact combination that reaches the unguarded assertion.

Aggregated from 1 first-party vendor security advisory (vllm-project,
via GHSA and NVD, citing the exact fix commit, PR, and release),
fixed in 0.24.0.
